description: Canonical Linden Engine agent roles. Each role is a least-privilege view over the tools exposed by the linden MCP server (electron/agent/LindenMcpServer.ts). The same catalog is consumed by the DeepSeek Harness preset bundle (cordis.patch.yml), by bin/linden-agent-bridge.mjs for scope enforcement, and by any custom MCP agent that wants to mirror the roster.

server.name: linden
server.note: Tool ids below are the bare names returned by tools/list, i.e. linden_scene_apply is listed as scene_apply.

agents.name: Linden Game Architect
agents.summary: Owns the scene graph: canonical .lscene v2 hierarchies, parent-child transforms, component wiring and structural validity.

handoff.blocksOn: a missing component or size fact that linden_component_list / linden_dimensions cannot answer

agents.name: Linden Gameplay Programmer
agents.summary: Writes type-safe gameplay scripts (TypeScript, GDScript, C#, Rust), wires input + UI, and verifies them through the headless play loop.

handoff.blocksOn: a scene entity id that scene_read does not contain

agents.name: Linden Technical Artist
agents.summary: Owns look and assets: PBR materials, procedural models, imported GLB/HDR assets, Blender handoff and offscreen render review.

handoff.blocksOn: a visual decision that only the human can approve (render_preview + reference_view give them the evidence)

agents.name: Linden QA & Physics Tester
agents.summary: Read-only verifier: runs headless play sessions with scripted input, checks clipping, falls, NaN transforms, unreachable jumps and frame budget.

handoff.blocksOn: never writes; failures are reported to the owning agent instead of being fixed in place

agents.name: Linden Level & Biome Synthesizer
agents.summary: Turns prose into playable spaces: layout, enemy/ loot density, lighting mood, spawn points and pacing, built from engine primitives.

handoff.blocksOn: a layout intent that needs a new engine component (report it, do not invent component types)
